user.title: ZTE MF LTE modem
user.description: The modem's own web interface address, and the password you use to sign in to it. Note that the modem locks logins for a while after a few wrong attempts, so avoid guessing.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the modem at that address.
error.locked: The modem has run out of login attempts. Power-cycle it or wait, then try again.
error.unsupported_firmware: This firmware uses a password scheme this integration does not implement.
error.busy: Another client is using the modem's single session — close its web interface and try again.

abort.already_configured: This modem is already set up.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read the modem. The modem keeps a single session, so polling too often is not free.
